rule: A host version that is not pinned is unsupported for that host only. It does not mark another host or a metric category unsupported.
pass_condition: A pinned host passes only when a real smoke collects a Skill or Tool call event. A parser fixture is not that evidence. Failure marks only that host unsupported.

completion_gate.statement: Fallback completion gate from ADR 0001 section 6: at least one pinned host must collect a Skill or Tool call event in a real smoke for the component-call requirement to count as done. If both pinned hosts end up unsupported, the R1 gate fails and returns to the user for a new decision; it must not be released.

omp.evidence: Real `omp -p` invocation on this host produced a real `read` toolCall (`call-d9b26888-01fc-4abd-aa3d-70b9f7840f07-0|fc_f54d5b30-39ec-90ed-8dad-17bd5574bee2_0`) and toolResult `11aef67c` in session 2026-10-16T17-06-22-104Z_01a145ad-d318-7734-8b78-7402c5b01884.jsonl; omp_adapter emitted invocation.started + invocation.finished (tool:read, duration_ms 27, wall) and the event store accepted both; re-ingest returned 2 duplicates and replay stayed at 2. Receipt and raw line snippets are in ai/tasks/v2.1.0-rc.1-r1.2b-host-adapters/task.md.

codex.evidence: Codex is not installed or run in this repository. The real smoke follows the exact instructions in sbtd-runtime/docs/host-adapters.md and is executed by a separate operator.

smoke_note: R1.2b owns the real host smoke. This file only freezes the R1.0 pin, the single-host unsupported rule, and the fallback completion-gate decision rule. smoke.omp is a real-run pass on 2026-10-17; smoke.codex stays pending until the codex@0.163.0 smoke in sbtd-runtime/docs/host-adapters.md is executed. A parser fixture is never smoke evidence.
